mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering and then recovering useful substances made it clear why the kidney does more than simply remove waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable.

surprise.text: The filter let useful glucose and water through along with waste; the recovery tube takes much of that back.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. I inspected the recovered fluid because I wasn't sure how to reach urine; the compatibility hint supplied the next connection.

continue.text: I would continue: following the fluid from filtering through recovery and into the bladder made an unfamiliar process easier to picture.
